sql: SELECT p.`1` AS id,p.`2` AS status,p.`3` AS quantity,CAST(p.`4` AS STRING) AS amount,p.`5` AS active,CAST(p.`6` AS STRING) AS unsigned_quantity,CAST(p.`7` AS STRING) AS wide_amount FROM (SELECT from_json(props_json,'STRUCT<`1`:STRING,`2`:STRING,`3`:BIGINT,`4`:DECIMAL(18,2),`5`:BOOLEAN,`6`:DECIMAL(20,0),`7`:DECIMAL(38,6)>',map('mode','FAILFAST')) AS p FROM spark_catalog.sdk_ashlar.object_current WHERE source_system='typed-sdk-local' AND type_id=17) ORDER BY id
